speaker.jigoku_pilot: Zeon remnant army grunt pilot (serving under Major Yonem Kirks)

132:19.en: 「Can I do this...? No, I have to!」

alternatives: I've waited so long for this day...!
I'll hit you in the power core!
I'll hit the power unit dead-on!
This ammo is precious! I can't miss!

132:190.en: 「Either my barrel melts or you fall!」
alternatives: My barrel burns out, or you fall!

132:283.en: 「If I grapple you at close range...!!」
alternatives: If I can force a grapple...!!

132:617.en: 「I'll go as often as it takes!」
alternatives: I'll come at you again and again!
Gundam or not,\nit's still an MS!
You devil! We meet in battle again!
Hear us, Gundam! Hear our hatred!
What can a fake Gundam possibly do!

132:1064.en: 「My skill can close the power gap!」
alternatives: Skill will make up the power gap!

132:1099.en: 「I should have the edge in agility!」
alternatives: We should have the edge in agility!
You'd face me in that weak unit...!

132:1247.en: 「You and I are both dogs of war!」
alternatives: You and I are dogs of the same war!
So the newest AS has arrived!

132:1344.en: 「Take out their ace and crush morale!」
alternatives: Down their ace and morale crumbles!
Crush their leader, and we can win!
The battleship is our top priority!
Those moves are stiff... A rookie?

132:1545.en: 「So young... Your moves give it away!」

alternatives: You thought you took me down?!
I won't let you get any cockier!

132:1732.en: 「I won't let this chance get away!」
alternatives: I won't let this chance slip away!

132:1794.en: 「I'll repay you, once and for all!」
alternatives: I'll repay my debt, no matter what!
Time to show the soul of Zeon!

132:1919.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」
alternatives: I won't stand by and let you!

132:1946.en: 「Some glory can only be won alive!」
alternatives: Some glory is only won by living!
I'll take them down for certain!

132:2134.en: 「If we bring our numbers to bear...!」

alternatives: I'll focus on holding them back!

132:2274.en: 「Tch! I let the perfect chance slip!」
alternatives: Tch! I missed the perfect chance...!

132:2311.en: 「Damn! I'm a sitting duck like this!」

alternatives: Ngh! Am I finally out of options?!
Even my energy has run dry...!
This machine and I still have it!
They missed...! The tide is turning!
My unit's weaker, but I'm better!
That's it! I'm not easy to hit!
Power means nothing if it can't hit!
A Gundam alone won't make you win!

132:2941.en: 「A fake is still just a fake!」

alternatives: GM types are easy prey as ever!
All for show, you hollow dummy!
So you're as weak as you look!

132:3189.en: 「You brat! Run home to your mommy!」
alternatives: You brat! Run home to your mama!
You're too green to be in battle!
If I can deflect it with this...!
I'll take it on the shield!
I'll block it with the shield!

132:3457.en: 「Doesn't look like much of an enemy!」

132:3560.en: 「A scratch or two means nothing now!」

alternatives: Your attack won't stop my momentum!
Cheap tricks are all you're good at!
Old model or not, I can still...!

132:3851.en: 「Damn you! Don't think this is over!」

alternatives: I can't keep taking these hits...!
A moment later and I'd be dead...!
They don't hesitate...! A tough foe!
My controls haven't been taken out!
Will a Gundam defeat me again...!

132:4252.en: 「This is the White Devil, or worse!」
alternatives: This thing...! White Devil or worse!

132:4361.en: 「I can't even beat a fake Gundam!?」
alternatives: I can't even beat a fake Gundam?!

132:4490.en: 「C-Could that one...!\nBe a $$ニュータイプ$$!?」

alternatives: I can't keep up...!\nCan it be...?!

132:4600.en: 「No! That sheer power will crush me!」

alternatives: Ngh! That speed is too much for me!

132:4684.en: 「I dismissed it as small, and now...!」

alternatives: Whoa!? Is that thing a monster?!
N-no! I won't let you! I won't!

132:5080.en: 「If need be, I'll die in a charge!」
alternatives: If it comes to it, I'll ram you!
If I run, my ten years mean nothing!

132:5162.en: 「As long as it moves, I'll fight on!」

alternatives: My machine and I are worn...! But!

132:5240.en: 「No retreat! I'll fight to the end!」

132:5426.en: 「I-Is this as far as I go!?」
alternatives: I-is this as far as I go?!
